remarks: Updated 2-Bedroom Condo with Private Balcony & Parking - This sunny and stylish 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo offers easy living on the second floor of a well-kept community. The heart of the home is a completely renovated kitchen featuring all-new appliances, sleek cabinetry, and modern finishes-ready for your favorite meals and gatherings. The spacious primary bedroom opens to a private balcony-your own outdoor retreat-while the second bedroom makes a great guest space or home office. The full bath has been recently remodeled with fresh, contemporary touches, and there's a convenient half bath for guests. With an assigned parking space and a smart layout that balances comfort and function, this move-in-ready condo is perfect for today's lifestyle.
